title: Prairie Ridge Renewal Calendar and Continuous Coverage Terms
content:
Every Medicaid Managed Care Membership renews once per eligibility period, and its renewal calendar is keyed to the renewal due date. The lead days, the reconsideration period and the continuous coverage terms of each eligibility category are these.

## Renewal calendar by category

| Category | Eligibility period (months) | Renewal packet issued (days before renewal due date) | First reminder (days before) | Second reminder (days before) | Ex parte renewal from data sources | Reconsideration period (days after a procedural coverage end date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult | 12 | 60 | 30 | 10 | Yes | 90 |
| Prairie Ridge Family Care | 12 | 60 | 30 | 10 | Yes | 90 |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | 12 | 60 | 30 | 10 | Yes | 90 |
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | 12 | 60 | 30 | 10 | Yes | 90 |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 12 | 60 | 30 | 10 | Yes | 90 |
| Prairie Ridge ABD Care | 12 | 90 | 45 | 15 | No | 90 |
| Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | 12 | 90 | 45 | 15 | No | 90 |

## Continuous coverage terms by category

| Category | Continuous eligibility (months) | Postpartum coverage (months after the month the pregnancy ends) |
|---|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult | 0 (none) | 0 (not applicable) |
| Prairie Ridge Family Care | 0 (none) | 0 (not applicable) |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | 12 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | 12 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 0 (none) | 12 |
| Prairie Ridge ABD Care | 0 (none) | 0 (not applicable) |
| Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | 0 (none) | 0 (not applicable) |

## Meaning of each term

- **Eligibility period.** The length of one eligibility period between renewals, in calendar months: 12 in every category.
- **Packet and reminder lead days.** Calendar days before the renewal due date on which the renewal packet, the first reminder and the second reminder are sent.
- **Ex parte renewal.** Where Yes, the state may renew the category from data sources without a returned packet. Prairie Ridge ABD Care and Prairie Ridge Dual Complete are not renewed ex parte.
- **Reconsideration period.** Calendar days after a procedural coverage end date during which a returned renewal reinstates coverage without a new application: 90 in every category.
- **Continuous eligibility.** Months from the coverage start date or the latest renewal during which coverage cannot end for income or procedural reasons; 0 means the category has none.
- **Postpartum coverage.** Months of coverage guaranteed after the month the pregnancy ends; only Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care has it.

## Hypothetical calendar

*A hypothetical renewal due date of 30 June.*

| Category group | Packet | First reminder | Second reminder |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lead days 60, 30 and 10 | 1 May | 31 May | 20 June |
| Lead days 90, 45 and 15 | 1 April | 16 May | 15 June |
